title: Login fails even with the correct password
body: Users report that logging in is rejected even when they type the correct password. The token and password formatting looks fine in the UI, so the problem seems to be in how credentials are verified during login. Valid users cannot authenticate.

title: API returns 500 on /users endpoint
body: Hitting GET /users intermittently returns a 500 error instead of the list of users. Other routes like /health are unaffected. Looks like the response handler blows up in some cases.

title: Database connection pool exhausted under load
body: Under sustained load the service stops responding because the database connection pool runs out of connections. New requests block forever. We likely need to fix connection reuse and/or raise the configured pool size.
